title: Ashfall: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Ashfall failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Name The Failure
blocks.body: When Ashfall feels unfair, name the thing that ended the route: thirst, hunger, darkness, hazard damage, full inventory, missing map marks, broken power, or no exit.

blocks.title: Shrink The Route
blocks.body: Return to a known loop and test one fix. A shorter route with a clear result teaches more than another long trip that fails in three different ways.

blocks.title: Recovery Kit
blocks.body: Carry the smallest kit that answers your last failure: water for thirst, food for time, light for navigation, filters for range, and scanner reads for unknown hazards.
blocks.label: Filtered Water Bottle
blocks.subtitle: Route recovery supply

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Changing three things at once can hide the part that mattered. Change one variable, run a smaller test, then decide whether the loop is safer.
